summary:
iter338 review of Title-Case name bug + web/mobile dashboard label capitalisation + mobile Provider Switch colored redesign. BACKEND (5/5 pytest passing in /app/backend/tests/test_iter338_titlecase.py): peter@test.com login + /auth/me return name='Peter Smith', first_name='Peter', last_name='Smith' Title-Cased (DB stored lowercase, serialiser _user_public applies _titlecase_name). /api/participants (core1) + /api/v2/participants (batch3) return participant first_name/last_name Title-Cased. lib.text_utils.title_case_name preserves McDonald and capitalises o'brien -> O'brien correctly. WEB (peter@test.com, /app/dashboard): 'Welcome back, Peter Smith' toast ✅, greeting 'Good afternoon, Peter' ✅, DashboardActionBar tiles show 'Upload a Statement', 'Check an Invoice', 'Draft a Letter', 'Ask Wayly a Question', 'See My Budget', 'All AI Tools' — all Title-Cased with minor words ('a'/'an') lowercase and 'AI' acronym preserved ✅. MOBILE (Expo, peter@test.com): 'HOUSEHOLD Peter Smith' pill ✅, greeting 'Good afternoon, Peter' ✅, DashboardActionBar same 6 tiles Title-Cased ✅. Mobile /provider-switch: psw1-list-root + psw1-empty + psw1-new-btn present, empty state renders with clay-toned card ✅. Mobile /switch-settlement/{sid}: psw1-settlement-root + psw1-settle-create-form present with 'Refund expected (AUD)' input + Calculation basis Required select + 'Create settlement' teal button ✅. 

**REGRESSION BUG FOUND**: /api/account (batch3_routes.py:207-221) returns raw participant docs WITHOUT title-casing, so `first_name`/`last_name` come back lowercase for peter's account. Web ParticipantsContext.jsx:35 calls /account and drives the dashboard 'Viewing care for peter smith' pill (data-testid=dashboard-viewing-for) — the pill renders LOWERCASE 'peter smith', breaking the review-request rule that names must be Title Case everywhere. This is HIGH priority — Peter (or any other lowercase-stored user) will see lowercase participant names on the dashboard.

Mobile decision-walkthrough (/switch-decision/{sid}) could not be fully verified through the browser session: after login on the Expo preview, follow-on navigations to /provider-switch and /switch-decision/{sid} raised 401s on the API calls (session cookie/token not persisted across page.goto in the automation), so psw1-walkthrough-root did not render and the list appeared empty even though the switch was created via curl. Same session did successfully load the settlement page shell (psw1-settlement-root + psw1-settle-create-form) because that route renders its create-form before the auth-required load completes. This is an automation-session issue, not necessarily a UI bug — main agent should re-verify walkthrough 1→5 with a real sign-in.

critical.issue: Returns participants with raw lowercase first_name/last_name (e.g. 'peter'/'smith'). Missing the title_case_name pass that /api/participants and /api/v2/participants apply. Fix: in batch3_routes.py get_account() apply title_case_name to first_name/last_name/preferred_name/name for each participant in `parts` before returning (mirror the loop in list_v2_participants).

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'Viewing care for peter smith' in lowercase because ParticipantsContext uses /api/account which returns lowercase names. Downstream fix (recommended, defensive): also Title-Case displayName in ParticipantsContext.jsx before setItems, so the UI is safe regardless of endpoint output.

parity_issues.issue: Mobile dashboard shows 'HOUSEHOLD Peter Smith' Title-Cased; web shows 'Viewing care for peter smith' lowercase. Divergence caused by web using /api/account (not title-cased) while mobile pulls from a source that IS title-cased.

action_items: HIGH: In /app/backend/batch3_routes.py get_account() (line 207-221), apply lib.text_utils.title_case_name to each participant's first_name/last_name/preferred_name/name before returning — mirror the loop already in list_v2_participants (batch3_routes.py:237-241). This fixes the 'Viewing care for peter smith' lowercase pill on the web dashboard and any other consumer of /account.
Optional defensive: title-case first_name/last_name in /app/frontend/src/context/ParticipantsContext.jsx refresh() before storing, so the UI is safe even if a backend endpoint returns raw casing.

Follow-up manual verification: mobile /switch-decision/{sid} 5-step walkthrough (step-1..5, next/back/submit, done) could not be exercised in this run due to a session-persistence issue in the Expo web preview; recommend a quick manual pass after the /account fix.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/batch3_routes.py get_account (line 207) inconsistent with list_v2_participants (line 227): only the latter title-cases participant name fields. The whole point of iter337/338 was Title Case everywhere — /account is a regression gap that leaks lowercase names to the web dashboard.

frontend/src/context/ParticipantsContext.jsx builds `name` from raw first_name+last_name; when the source endpoint returns lowercase, downstream UI breaks. A single title-case call at ingestion would make the client robust to backend regressions.

backend/routes/psw1.py POST /participants/{pid}/switches requires initial_reason_for_switch from a strict VALID_REASONS set of 9 values (billing_disputes_unresolved, care_quality_declined, worker_experience_issues, provider_communication_breakdown, financial_reasons, location_change, care_manager_concerns, care_plan_alignment_issues, other). Any client picker must map to those exact strings — good defensive validation.
mobile/app/provider-switch.tsx psw1-empty is a clay-toned card with 'No provider switches in progress.' — matches the review-request colored redesign spec.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 pytest — login, /me, /participants, /v2/participants, edge cases); but /api/account not title-cased is a regression not covered by iter338 test
success_rate.frontend: web 85% (dashboard labels + login toast + greeting all pass; participant pill FAILS due to /account lowercase); mobile 95% (dashboard labels ✅ + provider-switch list shell ✅ + settlement shell ✅; walkthrough not verified live due to automation session issue)

rca of the issue: Bug: 'Viewing care for peter smith' web pill renders lowercase. Reproduction: (1) Login as peter@test.com on web preview → /app/dashboard. (2) Header pill 'Viewing care for peter smith' visible below the greeting (Title-Cased 'Peter'). (3) `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" /api/account` returns participants[0].first_name='peter', last_name='smith' — LOWERCASE. Root cause: batch3_routes.py:207 get_account() returns _active_participants(...) verbatim; only the /v2/participants sibling (line 227) applies title_case_name. The other read-serialisers (_user_public in server.py:288, core1._participant_public, participant_profile._decorate) DO title-case, but /account slipped through. Mitigation: add the same title_case loop from list_v2_participants (batch3_routes.py:237-241) inside get_account() before returning the response, OR title-case in ParticipantsContext client-side for a defence-in-depth fix. Preferred: fix backend so all consumers of /account get consistent output.
